import http.client

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/checklist/list_item_observations?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Bid%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bitem_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bcreated_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bupdated_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&sort=SOME_STRING_VALUE", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
